theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_good_radius_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f k : ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → MonotoneOn f (Ioi 0) → MonotoneOn k (Ioi 0) → (∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → 0 ≤ f τ ∧ f τ ≤ F) → (∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → 0 ≤ k τ) → (∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → f s / s ^ n ≤ f r / r ^ n + ∫ τ in Ioc s r, k τ / τ ^ n) → (∀ η : ℝ, η < 1 → ∃ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), η < f s / s ^ n) → 0 < F ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < 2 * F ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ ∧ f (5 * r) ≤ 5 ^ n * F ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * k r
